title: Two days in Ninh Binh
summary: Trang An and Hoa Lu on the first day. Bai Dinh, Van Long, and Phat Diem on the second. Hang Mua is a separate half day. Every clock on site is Check on arrival.

days.title: Day 1 — Trang An and Hoa Lu
days.body: Sit the sampan at Trang An. An adult over 1.3 m is 300,000 đồng. Walk Hoa Lu if the morning is still open. An adult ticket there is 20,000 đồng.

days.title: Day 2 — Bai Dinh, Van Long, Phat Diem
days.body: Bai Dinh, then Van Long, then Phat Diem if the afternoon is open. An adult at Van Long is 100,000 đồng. Bai Dinh and Phat Diem fees are Check on arrival. How long each one takes is Check on arrival.
